description: Defines the RendererImplFactory class for creating Renderer instances, including dependencies, configuration, and methods for creating decoders and renderers within the media namespace.

classes.name: RendererImplFactory
classes.description: A final class implementing RendererFactory, responsible for creating Renderer instances with support for audio/video decoders and GPU acceleration.

methods.name: CreateRenderer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Renderer instance configured with provided task runners, sinks, overlay info callback, and color space.

methods.name: CreateAudioDecoders
methods.description: Creates a list of audio decoders using the media task runner.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoders
methods.description: Creates a list of video decoders with support for GPU acceleration and overlay info.
